newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Stampede at Zaire soccer ground kills at least two.
newsitem.headline: Stampede at Zaire soccer ground kills at least two.

text.p: At least two people died in a stampede during a soccer match on Sunday at the national stadium in the Zairean capital, witnesses said.
Red Cross officials said at least 50 injured fans were taken to hospital in Kinshasa but they had no immediate details on deaths.
Witnesses said at least five ambulances rushed to the Chinese-built stadium, which was built to take 80,000 spectators and was full at the time.
Witnesses said the stampede followed a disputed goal during a match between Zairean rivals Vita Club and DCMP.
Soldiers fired teargas into the crowd after a pitch invasion when DCMP disputed a goal that gave Vita Club a 2-0 lead, they added.
